evals.prompt: A new Farplane project is being initialized for autonomous operation. What should the generated automation surfaces contain?

farplane.title: Init advisor emits one Pulse heartbeat and separate scheduled jobs

evals.prompt: The initialized project has local tickets and a Pulse automation. What should the template say about selecting work?
evals.expected_output: Pulse dispatches unclaimed executable tickets up to the configured Pulse-worker limit and makes due original-ticket check-ins eligible; Human-active tickets are unselectable but consume no Pulse capacity and do not block refill; Pulse reads harness areas, metric objectives and guards, a recent global ticket-history sample, and current reports when the executable board is empty; The adaptive planner progressively filters history only when needed and creates bounded globally ranked specs; Feed Scout, Interval, and Dogfood may create bounded evidence-backed direct recovery tickets but supply opportunities, uncertain fixes, and experiments only as candidates; No separate ticket-drainer or check-in automation is required
assertions: Pulse dispatches unclaimed executable tickets up to the configured Pulse-worker limit and makes due original-ticket check-ins eligible
Human-active tickets are unselectable but consume no Pulse capacity and do not block refill
The adaptive planner reads a recent global ticket-history sample before optional progressive filters
Feed Scout, Interval, and Dogfood may create bounded evidence-backed direct recovery tickets but supply opportunities, uncertain fixes, and experiments only as candidates
Local ready and unblocked tickets are preferred over blocked or approval-required work
Substantial implementation routes through harness-creator first when the operating model is missing, then goal-advisor only after a concrete milestone exists
No separate ticket-drainer or check-in automation is required because Pulse owns selection, execution, and due check-in dispatch
